title: Zephyrine and the Recipe
author: Quentin Amberdale
blurb: Ansel Okafor, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
